snippet.title: People are Tools | Official Gameplay Trailer #2
snippet.description:
Out May 1st!!

Wishlist us now 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4518730/People_are_Tools/#game_area_purchase

⚒️ Your friends are your only gear! In this chaotic co-op adventure, use your teammates as pickaxes, grapples, and tools to navigate procedurally generated caves and find fuel for your ship. Just remember: you’re not alone down here...
